description: Update a client's name/address/city/state/zip, and set a client-level email/phone (used for invoices/payment links when a booking has no contact email). Optional note appends a note to the client's history (same as add_client_note).

id.description: The record's numeric id, from the matching list/get/search tool.

name.description: A name (person or company, depending on the tool).

state.description: US state as a 2-letter code, e.g. MI.

name: update_client
title: Update Client
